_note: Authoritative host, toolchain, and clock reference for the separate sm_86 SOL workload launch-set v3 campaign. The SOL adapter build/capture contract is pinned to nvcc release 13.2; this document is intentionally distinct from campaign_protocol_pins.json, whose canonical C1 compiler release is 13.3. These are provenance/environment pins only; no NCU metric value is a pin.

toolchain._nvcc_note: The SOL live-v2 environment and capture_toolchain_contract.py require the CUDA 13.2 nvcc release. This is not an alternative accepted release for canonical C1; it is a campaign-specific retained authority.

reference_clock_state._note: The v2.1 reference config (clock=none x cache=all) is captured with host persistence enabled and clocks locked to these device-local values.
